introduction: Nebraska weatherization services are arranged by regional nonprofit providers. The provider checks eligibility and performs an energy audit before scheduling approved work.
description: Nebraska weatherization services are arranged by regional nonprofit providers. The provider checks eligibility and performs an energy audit before scheduling approved work.

sections.who: Eligible low-income homeowners and renters can apply. Renters need written landlord permission. Priority and funding availability affect scheduling; eligibility does not guarantee immediate service.
sections.get: Measures may include insulation, sealing drafts and selected heating-efficiency or safety work. The state specifically excludes general roof replacement, siding repairs and replacement windows.
sections.docs:
• Prepare income and household information.
  • Have utility records and property details available.
  • For a rental, ask about written permission from the owner.
  • Tell the provider about any previous weatherization.
sections.apply:
1. Find the regional provider

    Use the map and links on Nebraska’s weatherization page.

  2. Complete local intake

    Ask about the checklist and waiting list, then submit the application to the provider.

  3. Arrange the audit

    Discuss the home’s energy problems and review the measures the audit supports.
sections.after: Confirm the work scope and appointments. Keep the provider’s maintenance guidance and ask about the final inspection.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Nebraska weatherization scope and regional providers. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Yes, with written landlord permission and applicable program restrictions.
Can the program replace my roof?
The state excludes roof replacement, siding repairs and replacement windows from weatherization services.
Does financial eligibility guarantee work immediately?
No. The state says services depend on available funds and waiting lists may apply.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
